summary: Create one manager-level Health Park at Avenir record rather than a pending Jupiter Medical Center campus transaction. Direct manager, owner/developer, property-party and registry evidence verifies the closed ProjectCo, Fengate/Fund IV-Stonemont-Sina partnership, two-building healthcare scope and Jupiter Medical Center's tenant/operator role. The development is under construction with no pending ownership transaction.
